findings.text: follow-on: the gate log's first line names '# rev 8a63ba5cd' (the base) but the run it records is the head: it collects 54 items including test_content_arm_asks_every_content_question, which does not exist at 8a63ba5cd (base arm is 47 tests). negative-control.log carries the same base-rev header. A later reader trusting the header would read the gate as pre-change; the tested content is the head at b62160566.

follow-on: the done-when requires the live check to record each facet and the grade with a confidence above zero on five files; the run's own live-check.log exits 2 with ABSENCE [('.../mgset0.f', 'relevance_grade')] because that file's grade returned confidence 0 while four of five did not. The attribution (the endpoint returned confidence 0 with a real distribution, reproduced on every call) is corroborated by the node's own raw probe (raw-one.log shows probabilities summing to 1 and "confidence": 0), so it is an endpoint/model matter rather than a recorder defect - but the done-when bullet is unmet as written and the fragment records it honestly rather than concealing it.

item_verdicts.diff: I read both commits against base 8a63ba5cd: one production change in workers.py (with_content=True), one recorder guard and a small reflow in scorer.py, a parametrised refusal test, a request/persisted-facets test, and a new evidence fragment; no graph write and no discover run.
item_verdicts.done_when: The four done-when bullets that this node owns are met: the request test, the persisted-facets assertion, the refusal test and the reproducing negative control, with a green gate (54 passed). The fifth - the live check recording each facet and the grade with confidence above zero on five files - is met on four of five files and unmet on mgset0.f's grade.
item_verdicts.goal: The node asks the content stage its five Score questions (workers.py:456) and _relevance_item fails closed on an unanswered facet or grade (scorer.py:344-357); delivered, with the live-check grade-confidence caveat treated as a follow-on.
item_verdicts.manifest: The reviewed manifest states base 8a63ba5cd, head b62160566, the two commits, the changed paths, the gate and the negative control; it declares no baseline_suite/after_suite JSON arms, so this review supplied the base arm.
item_verdicts.write_paths: All five changed files lie inside the declared write paths; no out-of-scope path is touched.

justifications.durability: the negative control genuinely reddens the request test rather than a trivial path; the recorder guard is exercised by a parametrised test over all five questions and a positive test that a complete answer records the facets; if the guard fires in the worker the batch exception path releases the claims (workers.py:638-643) so no zero is written, which is the fail-closed behaviour the plan names.
justifications.evidence: the gate is green (54 passed, EXIT=0) and I re-ran both arms independently on this allocation: base 8a63ba5cd 47 passed EXIT=0, head b62160566 54 passed EXIT=0, so the added-failure set is empty. The negative control reproduces (mutating workers.py to build_triage_questions() makes test_content_arm_asks_every_content_question fail with 'content request omitted data_access_depth', EXIT=1). The live check is honest but exits 2: it flags the grade's confidence-0 absence on mgset0.f, which is one done-when bullet unmet; the same run's gate.log and negative-control.log headers name rev 8a63ba5cd (the base) although both ran the head content.
justifications.fit: two conventional commits, both with substantive bodies ('fix(discovery): ask the content stage its five Score questions', 'docs(evidence): record the content-stage Score questions and their live check'), zero AI attribution lines, and mechanism names (with_content, FACET_QUESTION_FIELDS, RELEVANCE_GRADE_QUESTION, _content_top_levels) carrying no plan, sprint or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the node goal is that the content stage ask its five Score questions and refuse to persist an unasked one; score_worker now builds build_triage_questions(with_content=True) (imas_codex/discovery/code/workers.py:456) and _relevance_item raises for a content-stage answer set missing any facet question or relevance_grade (imas_codex/discovery/code/scorer.py:344-357), so both halves land. One done-when bullet is not fully met: the live check records the grade with confidence above zero on four of five files, and mgset0.f's grade returns confidence 0.
justifications.reuse: the change reuses the existing owners: build_triage_questions(with_content=True) (scorer.py:178), the existing FACET_QUESTION_FIELDS/RELEVANCE_GRADE_QUESTION constants and _content_top_levels, and the existing apply_file_scores write path; no second question set or second recorder is forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff base..head touches five files and every one is inside the declared write paths (imas_codex/discovery/code/workers.py, imas_codex/discovery/code/scorer.py, tests/discovery/test_code_relevance.py, tests/discovery/test_code_facet_admission.py, docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/content-score-questions.html); no out-of-scope path is touched.
